entities.name: Felix Sandström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Per Felix Sandström is a Swedish professional ice hockey goaltender for Oulun Kärpät of the Finnish Liiga. He previously played parts of three seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL). Sandstrom was selected by the Philadelphia Flyers in the third round of the 2015 NHL entry draft.
